purpose: Warning codes whose NVIDIA guidance requires an operator action. Fleet keeps their component state Healthy, so the GPUAlert event rule (gpuops-xid-sxid-rca) raises them from Fleet event lines; Fatal/Critical codes come from the state rule (gpuops-xid-sxid-state).

basis.fleet: Pinned Fleet SDK 84f99bee catalog event_type (rcca-agent/runbooks/catalog-manifest.json fleet_event_type)
basis.xid: NVIDIA Xid catalog (Xid-Catalog.xlsx, Sep 09, 2026) immediate-action bucket and GPU Node Triage table 1 (Oct 04, 2026)
basis.sxid: Fabric Manager User Guide v2.6 tables 23 (potentially fatal) and 24 (always fatal); table 25 SXID 10003 is fatal to the fabric/system
